zh.title: 波音未向工會說明後續是否裁員 737 MAX月產47架預期延至2027年初
zh.summary: 波音未向工會說明後續是否裁員；737 MAX月產47架預期延至2027年初
body: 波音在11月19日未向其規模最大的工會之一說明，預定下月進行的一輪裁員之後，是否還會有進一步裁員。該公司本月另宣佈，計畫裁減商用飛機部門員工的5%；該部門約有5萬名員工。
在生產方面，波音正力圖將737 MAX月產量由42架提升至47架，但增產面臨困難。公司原先預期在今年夏季達到每月47架；根據路透社，波音目前預期在2027年初達到這個產速。

en.title: Boeing declines to tell a union if more layoffs will follow; 737 MAX output target slips to 2027
en.summary: Boeing gives no answer to a union on further layoffs; 737 MAX output target slips to early 2027.
body: Boeing declined on November 19 to tell one of its largest unions whether further layoffs would follow a round of job cuts planned for next month. The company also announced this month that it would cut 5% of the roughly 50,000 employees in its commercial airplanes division.

Boeing is struggling to increase production of the 737 MAX from 42 jets a month to 47, a rate it had expected to reach this past summer. The company now expects to reach 47 jets a month in early 2027, according to Reuters.

zh.title: 波音埃弗里特 737 據報納入生產證書，仍待 FAA 完成稽核
zh.summary: The Air Current 引述知情人士報導，波音已將埃弗里特 North Line 製造的 737 納入 FAA 生產證書，擴產及新線交機仍待稽核完成。
body: 航空產業媒體 The Air Current 於 11 月 23 日引述知情人士報導，波音已將在華盛頓州埃弗里特新總裝線製造的 737 納入該廠的 FAA 生產證書 PC700。這條稱為 North Line 的產線，使波音能在倫頓之外組裝 737。
同一報導指出，波音仍在處理 FAA 稽核最後階段，完成後才可加快產量並向客戶交付由這條產線組裝的飛機。加入生產證書與開始交機是不同階段。

en.title: Boeing’s Everett 737 line reportedly added to production certificate, FAA audit still underway
en.summary: The Air Current reports that Boeing’s Everett-built 737s have been added to the facility’s FAA production certificate. The company is still undergoing the audit needed to raise output and begin deliveries from the line.
body: The Air Current reported on Nov. 23, citing people familiar with the matter, that Boeing has added 737s assembled in Everett, Washington, to the facility’s FAA production certificate, PC700. The North Line gives Boeing a 737 assembly location alongside Renton.

The publication said Boeing was still working through the final stages of an FAA audit needed before raising production and delivering customer aircraft from the new line. Certificate inclusion and the start of deliveries are separate milestones.

facts.claim: The Air Current reported that Everett-built 737s were added to the facility’s FAA production certificate, PC700.
Boeing is reportedly still completing an FAA audit before increasing output and delivering aircraft from its North Line.

zh.title: 新加坡航空開航西雪梨國際機場，首班由總理黃循財搭乘
zh.summary: 新加坡航空 11 月 23 日開航樟宜機場至西雪梨國際機場，以空中巴士 A350-900 每天直飛。新加坡總理黃循財搭乘首班航班。
body: 新加坡航空首班 SQ261 於 11 月 23 日晚間抵達西雪梨國際機場（WSI）。機場表示，新加坡總理黃循財隨同國會代表團搭乘首班航班。
這條每日直飛航線使用空中巴士 A350-900。西雪梨機場全天營運，從當地出發的航班安排接近午夜起飛，隔天清晨抵達新加坡樟宜機場（SIN）。

en.title: Singapore Airlines begins daily Western Sydney flights with PM Lawrence Wong on the first service
en.summary: Singapore Airlines began daily nonstop service between Changi and Western Sydney International Airport on Nov. 23. Singapore Prime Minister Lawrence Wong travelled on the inaugural Airbus A350-900 flight.
body: Singapore Airlines flight SQ261 arrived at Western Sydney International Airport (WSI) on the evening of Nov. 23. The airport said Prime Minister Lawrence Wong travelled with a parliamentary delegation on the first flight.

The daily nonstop service uses an Airbus A350-900. Western Sydney Airport (SYD) operates around the clock, allowing the Singapore-bound service to depart near midnight and reach Changi the following morning.

zh.title: Boom首度運轉原型引擎核心 擬供Overture客機引擎使用
zh.summary: Boom於十一月二十一日首度運轉原型引擎核心，擬供Overture客機引擎使用
body: Boom Supersonic於十一月二十一日首次運轉原型引擎核心，展開地面測試。公司計畫將這套硬體用於Overture客機的Symphony渦輪扇引擎。據Aviation Week，測試在Boom位於丹佛以東Watkins的Colorado Air and Space Port內的設施進行。
Boom的Sprint Core原型結合壓縮機、燃燒室及高壓渦輪。創辦人兼執行長Blake Scholl在X分享運轉影片；他向Aviation Week表示，核心在第二次嘗試時點火，轉速達每分鐘6,500轉。
為建造航空引擎，Boom還須加裝風扇及低壓級，並測試完整的Symphony渦輪扇引擎。

en.title: Boom runs prototype core intended for Overture engine for first time
en.summary: Boom Supersonic first ran its prototype engine core on 21 November; the hardware is intended for Overture’s engine.
body: Boom Supersonic ran its prototype engine core for the first time on 21 November, starting ground tests of hardware it plans to use in the Symphony turbofan for its Overture airliner. According to Aviation Week, the test took place at Boom’s facility at the Colorado Air and Space Port in Watkins, east of Denver.

Boom’s Sprint Core prototype combines a compressor, a combustor and a high-pressure turbine. Founder and chief executive Blake Scholl posted footage of the run on X. He told Aviation Week that the core ignited on the second attempt and reached 6,500 revolutions per minute.
To build the aircraft engine, Boom still needs to add the fan and low-pressure stages and test the complete Symphony turbofan.

zh.title: 英國空軍司令：無人戰機預計明年在英國空域飛行
zh.summary: 英國皇家空軍司令表示，無人戰機預計明年開始在英國空域飛行。
body: 英國皇家空軍司令Harv Smyth表示，無人戰鬥機預計明年開始在英國空域飛行。
Smyth也表示，Global Combat Air Programme（GCAP）正在開發的Tempest，可能是最後一款為皇家空軍打造的有人戰鬥機。
英國正加快對協同作戰飛機（collaborative combat aircraft，CCA）的投資，其中包括BAE Systems的Brontanax展示機。
Storm Fighter計畫旨在建立自主掌握的協同作戰飛機能力。英國政府於2026年公佈的國防投資計畫，確認承諾為Storm Fighter投入3億英鎊。

en.title: RAF chief says uncrewed fighters expected to fly in UK airspace next year
en.summary: The RAF chief says uncrewed fighters are expected to begin flying in UK airspace next year.
body: Royal Air Force chief Sir Harv Smyth says uncrewed fighter aircraft are expected to begin flying in UK airspace next year.
Smyth also suggested that Tempest, the fighter being developed under the Global Combat Air Programme (GCAP), could be the final crewed combat aircraft built for the RAF.
The UK is accelerating investment in collaborative combat aircraft (CCAs), including BAE Systems’ Brontanax demonstrator.

The Storm Fighter programme is intended to deliver a sovereign collaborative combat aircraft capability. The UK government’s Defence Investment Plan, published in 2026, confirmed a £300 million commitment to Storm Fighter.

zh.title: 波音獲美國空軍合約 增造15架KC-46A Pegasus加油機
zh.summary: 波音獲美國空軍合約增造15架KC-46A加油機；全球簽約或服役合計203架
body: 波音於2026年11月24日表示，已獲美國空軍合約，將增造15架KC-46A Pegasus空中加油機。
波音指出，全球共有203架KC-46A多任務空中加油機已簽約或投入使用，其中116架已交付美國空軍。
自2019年首架KC-46A Pegasus交付以來，美國空軍KC-46A機隊累計飛行時數已超過18萬小時。波音表示，這反映機隊在訓練及任務飛行方面的高使用率。
波音表示，KC-46A可快速調整配置，支援包括人道援助及救災在內的多種任務。

en.title: Boeing wins U.S. Air Force contract to build 15 more KC-46A Pegasus tankers
en.summary: Boeing wins U.S. Air Force contract for 15 KC-46A Pegasus tankers; 203 are contracted or in service globally.
body: Boeing said on Nov. 24, 2026, that it had been awarded a U.S. Air Force contract to build 15 additional KC-46A Pegasus aerial refueling tankers.
The company said 203 KC-46A multi-mission aerial refuelers are on contract or in service globally. That total includes 116 delivered to the U.S. Air Force.

Since the first KC-46A Pegasus was delivered in 2019, the U.S. Air Force’s KC-46A fleet has exceeded 180,000 flight hours, according to Boeing. The company said the figure reflects high use in training and operational sorties.
Boeing said the KC-46A can be rapidly reconfigured to support missions including humanitarian assistance and disaster relief.

zh.title: FAA收緊全美Line Up and Wait規定 機場延誤恐增加
zh.summary: FAA自11月24日起收緊全美Line Up and Wait規定，機場延誤恐增加。
body: FAA自11月24日起在全美針對「Line Up and Wait」作業實施更嚴格的規定。Simple Flying在報導標題中稱FAA禁止這項作業，並將禁令形容為「永遠」。
根據Simple Flying報導，收緊「Line Up and Wait」作業規定之際，正值管制人員短缺。報導也指出，美國機場的延誤可能因這項作業限制措施而增加。

en.title: FAA Tightens Line Up and Wait Rules Nationwide; US Airport Delays May Rise
en.summary: FAA tightens Line Up and Wait rules nationwide from November 24; US airport delays may increase.
body: The FAA is introducing stricter rules for Line Up and Wait operations nationwide, with the changes taking effect from November 24, according to Simple Flying. In its headline, the publication describes the agency’s move as a ban on those operations “forever.”

The changes come at a time when controllers are in short supply, according to Simple Flying. The publication says the restrictions could lead to an increase in delays at airports in the United States.

zh.title: 報導：五角大廈與通用汽車、福特汽車初步洽談軍用無人機零件供應
zh.summary: 五角大廈據報與通用汽車、福特汽車初步洽談軍用無人機零件供應，尚未達成協議。
body: AeroTime引述《華爾街日報》報導，五角大廈正與通用汽車、福特汽車及其他製造商初步洽談，討論為軍用無人機供應零件。討論中的方案擬由汽車企業向無人機製造商供應零組件，相關談判尚未達成協議。
《華爾街日報》另報導，通用汽車正在評估是否製造無人機馬達。AeroTime指出，五角大廈官員也曾與福特及加拿大汽車零件供應商Magna International的高層會晤。
福特向路透社表示，該公司與五角大廈的討論重點是軍用車輛及衛星相關工作。
五角大廈的Drone Dominance計畫提出，到2027年需要超過20萬架航空器。

en.title: Pentagon in early talks with General Motors and Ford on military drone parts: report
en.summary: Pentagon is reportedly in early military drone-parts talks with General Motors and Ford; no agreement has been reached.
body: The Pentagon is in preliminary talks with General Motors, Ford Motor Company and other manufacturers about supplying parts for military drones, according to a Wall Street Journal report cited by AeroTime. Under the arrangement being discussed, automotive companies would supply components to drone makers; the talks have not yet produced an agreement.

The Journal reported that GM is considering whether to make drone motors. Pentagon officials have also met executives from Ford and Canadian auto-parts supplier Magna International, AeroTime reported.
Ford told Reuters that its discussions with the Pentagon focused on military vehicles and satellite work.
The Pentagon's Drone Dominance program calls for more than 200,000 aircraft by 2027.

zh.title: 馬來西亞航空集團訂購10架波音787以替換空中巴士A350
zh.summary: 馬來西亞航空集團訂購10架波音787；預計於2032至2035年間交付；將逐步替換現有空中巴士A350機隊
body: 馬來西亞航空集團（MAG）已直接向波音公司訂購10架波音787夢幻客機，並附帶6架選擇權，以推動其長程機隊更新計畫。此筆訂單於2026年11月25日宣佈，新機將配備GE Aerospace GEnx-1B發動機，排定於2032年至2035年間進行交付，財務條款則未予公開。
該協議是在吉隆坡舉行的一場儀式中簽署，並由馬來西亞首相安華·依布拉欣出席見證。隨著新機陸續到位，馬來西亞航空將成為馬來西亞國內首家營運波音787機型的航空公司。
馬來西亞航空集團總裁兼集團執行長拿督納沙魯丁·阿巴斯表示，收購波音787夢幻客機代表了該集團對未來發展的一項策略性投資，有助於以更大的載客量、更高的效率與靈活性來服務關鍵國際市場。
這批波音787新機將逐步取代馬來西亞航空現有的7架空中巴士A350客機，馬來西亞航空集團計畫在2032年至2035年間同期間逐步退役A350機隊。新機將採三艙等配置共319個座位，預計投入倫敦、巴黎、雪梨、墨爾本、東京、大阪及首爾等歐洲與亞太航線。
除了廣體客機訂單外，馬來西亞航空集團也續約了GE Aerospace的Fuel Insight與FlightPulse軟體，以持續支援節油與營運決策。同時，馬來西亞航空目前營運超過37架波音737新世代客機與19架737-8，並擁有總計55架波音737的未交機訂單。

en.title: Malaysia Aviation Group Orders 10 Boeing 787s to Replace Airbus A350 Fleet
en.summary: Malaysia Aviation Group orders 10 Boeing 787s; deliveries scheduled between 2032 and 2035; aircraft to replace Airbus A350s
body: Malaysia Aviation Group (MAG) has ordered 10 Boeing 787 Dreamliners directly from Boeing, with options for six more, as part of its long-haul fleet renewal. Announced on November 25, 2026, the aircraft will be powered by GE Aerospace GEnx-1B engines and scheduled for delivery between 2032 and 2035, with financial terms undisclosed.

The agreement was signed at a ceremony in Kuala Lumpur attended by Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim. Upon delivery, Malaysia Airlines will become the first Malaysian airline to operate the Boeing 787.

Captain Nasaruddin A. Bakar, President and Group CEO of MAG, stated that the acquisition represents a strategic investment that strengthens the group's ability to serve international markets with greater capacity, efficiency, and flexibility.

The new Boeing 787s will gradually replace Malaysia Airlines' seven Airbus A350s, which MAG plans to phase out between 2032 and 2035. The aircraft will feature 319 seats in a three-class configuration and are expected to serve markets including London, Paris, Sydney, Melbourne, Tokyo, Osaka, and Seoul.

Alongside the widebody order, MAG renewed its agreement for GE Aerospace's Fuel Insight and FlightPulse software. Malaysia Airlines also operates over 37 Boeing 737 Next Generation aircraft and 19 737-8s, with an existing order book of 55 737s.

zh.title: Virgin Atlantic擬2027年3月在曼徹斯特引進空中巴士A330neo
zh.summary: Virgin Atlantic擬2027年3月在曼徹斯特引進A330neo。
body: Virgin Atlantic計畫自2027年3月起，在曼徹斯特的航線引進空中巴士A330neo，初期用於紐約（JFK）航班。6月起，該機型也將投入奧蘭多航班。
該公司調整曼徹斯特航網，決定自明年夏季起暫停拉斯維加斯航線。根據向航空分析公司Cirium申報的時刻資料，紐約航班明年4月至6月將由每日1班增至每週10班。奧蘭多航班在假期尖峯期間將達每週最多17班。
另外，Virgin Atlantic表示，倫敦希斯洛機場（LHR）的容量限制使其目前無法在該機場進一步擴張。

en.title: Virgin Atlantic plans Airbus A330neo flights from Manchester in March 2027
en.summary: Virgin Atlantic plans A330neo service from Manchester starting in March 2027.
body: Virgin Atlantic plans to introduce the Airbus A330neo at its Manchester hub from March 2027, starting on flights to New York (JFK). From June, the aircraft is also set to be deployed on flights to Orlando.

The airline has decided to suspend its Las Vegas route from Manchester starting next summer. Schedules filed with aviation analytics firm Cirium show that New York flights are due to rise from daily to 10 a week between April and June next year. Orlando flights will reach up to 17 a week during the holiday peak.
Separately, Virgin Atlantic says capacity limits at London Heathrow Airport (LHR) mean it cannot expand further there.
